title: Editor
subtitle: Adjust code display, indentation, and automatic formatting

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: These settings affect editor text and the cursor; adjust interface and chat text size on the Appearance page

behavior.title: Editing Behavior
behavior.description: Indentation settings affect newly entered text; word wrapping only changes how it is displayed

display.title: Display Settings
display.description: Visual guides help you navigate code and identify whitespace without changing file contents

advanced.title: Advanced Features
advanced.description: Highlighting changes how code looks; formatting and whitespace cleanup change the text

appearance.lineHeightDesc: A multiple of the font size; for example, 14 px text at 1.5 gives a 21 px line height

behavior.insertSpacesDesc: On: Tab inserts spaces up to the next tab stop. Off: inserts a tab character. Existing text is not converted.
behavior.scrollBeyondLastLineDesc: Scroll past the end of file to center content
behavior.tabSizeDesc: Character columns per tab stop; also sets the indentation width when using spaces
behavior.detectIndentationDesc: Use the file’s indentation when opening it; otherwise use the defaults above. Turn off to always use your defaults. The status bar changes only the current file.
behavior.detectIndentationUnsupported: This host does not support saving indentation detection settings. Upgrade the host to enable this option.

display.minimapDesc: Display code minimap on editor side

advanced.semanticHighlightingDesc: Color code by the meaning of symbols such as variables and functions
advanced.bracketPairColorizationDesc: Use different colors for nested bracket pairs
advanced.trimAutoWhitespaceDesc: Remove trailing whitespace left by automatic indentation and similar editor actions

messages.loadFailedLocked: Editor settings could not be read. This page is locked to avoid overwriting the current configuration with defaults.
messages.saveSuccess: Config saved, open editors will update
